40.title: Paginate the export endpoint
40.body:
Exports return every row at once. Page them with an opaque cursor.

## Acceptance
- `GET /export?cursor=…` returns at most 500 rows and a `next` cursor.
- Rows inserted during a paged read are not skipped.

42.title: Retry webhook deliveries with backoff
42.body:
Webhook deliveries are tried **once**; a 5xx or a timeout drops the event.

Retry with exponential backoff and jitter, up to 6 attempts over ~1 hour.

```go
type Retry struct { Attempts int; Base time.Duration }
```

44.title: Should exports stream CSV or build it in memory?
44.body:
Exports can reach 2 GB. Should the endpoint stream CSV rows as they are read, or build the file and serve it?

This is a question for a discuss run, not an implementation.

47.title: Migrate settings to TOML
47.body: Move `settings.yaml` to `settings.toml` and drop the YAML loader.

62.title: Retry webhook deliveries with jitter
62.body: Add jitter to the webhook retry backoff so that retries from one outage do not arrive together.

51.title: Rate-limit the public API
51.body:
The public API has no rate limit. Add a token bucket per API token: 60 requests a minute, bursts of 10.

- 429 with `Retry-After` when empty.
- Configurable in `settings.toml`.
